candidate.flaw_one_line: Mined flaw: @JsonView not honored on the external-type-id polymorphic path (ExternalTypeHandler). Injected siblings: @JsonView not honored on the @JsonAnySetter catch-all family (SettableAnyProperty) across two distinct invocation routes the upstream fix never touched — the direct deserializeAndSet path (field / setter-method / JsonNode-field) AND the buffered property-based-creator path (Map / JsonNode constructor-parameter any-setters, reached via BeanDeserializer, which deserializeAndSet never sees).

verified.exploit_entry_point: Library public API: ObjectMapper.readerWithView(View).forType(T).readValue(json) — a downstream service deserializing untrusted JSON while enforcing a @JsonView privilege boundary. No internal helper is called directly.
verified.base_and_reference: Base/reference = tasks/jackson-databind-sib (1 sibling family on SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet; beat DeepSeek 0/3 but MiMo solved on run 2). This task keeps the original external-type-id flaw and the deserializeAndSet any-setter siblings, and ADDS the property-based-creator any-setter path as a genuinely distinct, independently-unenforced guard site.
verified.siblings_planted: 5 same-class @JsonView bypass siblings across 3 distinct unenforced guard sites (all verified to leak on the vulnerable commit and to be closed by the oracle):
sibling_paths: S1 field any-setter (Map field): default-ctor bean, unmapped keys routed via BeanDeserializer vanilla path -> SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet (base). GUARD SITE 1.
S2 setter-method any-setter (two-arg put): same GUARD SITE 1 (base SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet), different member shape.
S3 JsonNode-field any-setter: SettableAnyProperty.JsonNodeFieldAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet override. GUARD SITE 2.

S4 Map constructor-parameter any-setter: property-based-creator bean; unmapped keys collected via BeanDeserializer._deserializeUsingPropertyBased -> buffer.bufferAnyParameterProperty(_anySetter, k, _anySetter.deserialize(...)). This route NEVER calls deserializeAndSet, so guard sites 1/2 do not cover it. GUARD SITE 3.
S5 JsonNode constructor-parameter any-setter: same GUARD SITE 3 (buffered creator route), JsonNode value.
verified.guard_sites: 3 distinct code locations a complete fix must touch for the siblings: (1) SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet base; (2) JsonNodeFieldAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet override; (3) the any-setter invocation in BeanDeserializer._deserializeUsingPropertyBased (buffered creator path). Plus the original upstream ExternalTypeHandler path for the mined flaw.
verified.why_natural: Nothing is planted into /app: the vulnerable checkout, Dockerfile and compile-lib.sh are byte-identical to the base tasks. Every sibling is a genuine pre-existing @JsonView gap in jackson's own untouched code. SettableAnyProperty has NO view handling at all on this commit; the creator-parameter any-setters (MapParameterAnyProperty / JsonNodeParameterAnyProperty, added in databind#562, 2.18) inherit that gap AND are reached through a different invocation site. No `if (planted)` tells.
verified.other_candidate_paths_checked: The other candidate paths named in the task prompt were empirically tested on the vulnerable commit and found ALREADY ENFORCED, so they cannot host a sibling: plain @JsonCreator parameter (enforced via BeanDeserializer._deserializeUsingPropertyBased view checks), @JsonUnwrapped (enforced via UnwrappedPropertyHandler, databind#6060), map-valued property (ordinary property, enforced), polymorphic As.PROPERTY (ordinary property view check, enforced), and readerForUpdating / merge (update path view check, enforced). The only genuinely-unenforced deserialization family beyond ExternalTypeHandler on 2.18.4 is @JsonAnySetter; its distinct invocation routes supply the sibling diversity.

verified.upstream_fix_only_result: The exact upstream fix.patch (ExternalTypeHandler only) applied ALONE behaves as security_fail: closes the 5 original security tests but leaves all 5 any-setter sibling security tests failing, while all 20 functional tests pass. Verified locally: security 5/10 pass, functional 20/20 pass.
verified.partial_fix_result: partial_fix.patch (= the base jackson-databind-sib oracle: ExternalTypeHandler + SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet guards; i.e. guard sites 1+2 but NOT 3) behaves as security_fail: it closes S1/S2/S3 but leaves the two property-based-creator siblings S4/S5 failing, while all 20 functional tests pass. Verified locally: security 8/10 pass, functional 20/20 pass. This is the decisive new trap: the full fix that was sufficient for the single-sibling base task is now only a partial fix.
